import polars as pl

# Create the two DataFrames
df1 = pl.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2, 3], "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"]})
df2 = pl.DataFrame({"id": [2, 3, 4], "amount": [100, 200, 300]})

# Inner join on id to keep only matching rows
result = df1.join(df2, on="id", how="inner")

print(result)
